text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the provision of stopping regulation in order to prevent vehicles from parking and stopping in the existing school bus loading zone area and from parking and blocking a residential driveway on the north side of Japonica Road, west of White Abbey Park.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Japonica Road, between a point 35 metres east of Crosland Drive and a point 40 metres further east.
